title: Theme the Data Parade newsroom and front end from the dataparade.io landing site
description: Tokens, fonts and logo from the dataparade.io landing app (colour tokens in its design file, Source Serif 4 headings, Inter body, teal brand, logo files). Newsroom: refined-newsprint Kanbus theme with --kb-theme-* overrides in publication/theme.css and a NewsroomLogo. Front end: web/css/site-theme.css and web/projection.json brandHtml and icons. The dataparade.io app itself is not changed.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Direction from the DataParade design-system canvas (claude.ai design artifact, Foundations board): the public article pages are marketing surfaces and follow the landing app's live tokens in landing/app/globals.css (canvas #f7f7f2, cards #ffffff, teal tint rgba(12,115,119,.1)/.2 dark, Source Serif 4 400 headings, 2px teal focus ring with 2px offset, radius 8/12) with the landing navbar and footer and its dp-landing-theme light/dark switch, done with the projection hooks module (masthead, footer, head_extra). The newsroom is an app surface and moves off the marketing cream to the canvas app neutrals (floor #f3f3f2, panel #ffffff, muted #eeeeed, border #e5e5e3, control border #d6d6d4), Inter only.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Shipped with PPY-be0f8d: article pages carry the dataparade.io navbar, footer, light/dark switch and post cards (web/hooks.py, web/css/site-theme.css); checked live and locally in light, dark and at phone width. Newsroom theme moved to the app neutrals (publication/theme.css) but not yet checked visually: /newsroom needs a Google sign-in. Close after a look at the newsroom.
